evaluation_policy: Temporal holdout only; all ice cells used in every year split
input_policy: Only current region ice cells; all other inputs and labels zero/masked
metric_unit: equal native ice cell/day weights; no area weighting

input_metadata.heat_flux_policy: ERA native signs preserved; units W/m2
input_metadata.rate_policy: ERA rates preserved in kg/m2/s; no daily-total conversion

derived_predictors.sfcwind: hypot(u10, v10) from daily mean components, m/s; not mean hourly speed

day_split.method: seeded random days within each year
